reg.notFound.text: This application does not exist, or it belongs to a premises you may not see. Go back to the list of applications and choose again.
reg.notAuthorised.title: Not recorded as acting for this premises
reg.notAuthorised.text: You are not recorded as acting for this premises at this moment, so nothing changed. If you are its principal or hold its delegation, check the delegates in the premises record, then try again.
reg.refusal.PREMISES_READ_UNAVAILABLE.ti: Your premises could not be read
reg.refusal.PREMISES_READ_UNAVAILABLE.te: RightOne could not read the premises record or your authority to act just now, so nothing was recorded. This is a fault on RightOne’s side; try again.
The data rules could not be checked
RightOne could not check the data rules for this information just now, so it was not saved. This is a fault on RightOne’s side; try again.
reg.refusal.PROCESSING_NOT_PERMITTED.tit: This personal data cannot be processed
reg.refusal.PROCESSING_NOT_PERMITTED.tex: RightOne may not process this personal data for registration, so it was not saved. This is a data-protection limit, not a mistake on your part; ask RightOne support how to continue.
The rules ask too many questions

The rules in force ask a premises to declare more than five facts, which is above the limit, so RightOne asks no further question and the application was not sent. The Policy owner has been told to correct the rules; your draft is kept.
reg.refusal.RULEBOOK_NOT_APPROVED.title: Registration rules not approved yet
reg.refusal.RULEBOOK_NOT_APPROVED.text: The registration rules are not approved yet, so the questions, the review and sending are not available. Your draft and saved answers are kept. This is for RightOne to resolve; there is nothing you need to do.
reg.refusal.TARIFF_NOT_APPROVED.title: No approved tariff yet
reg.refusal.TARIFF_NOT_APPROVED.text: No approved tariff applies on this date, so RightOne cannot work out the fee and nothing was recorded. The answers are kept; come back once the tariff is published.
reg.refusal.USE_START_REQUIRED.title: The rules do not ask when music began
reg.refusal.USE_START_REQUIRED.text: The rules in force do not ask the date the premises began playing music, which every decision must record, so the application cannot be reviewed or sent. The Policy owner has been told to correct the rules; your draft and answers are kept.
reg.refusal.EVIDENCE_NOT_REQUESTED.text: This document is not one the application asks for, so it was not accepted. Add it under an item that is still needed.

reg02.periodLine: The period starts today or later. If you began playing music earlier, you give that date on the next step, and the review shows whether anything is owed for that earlier time.
reg02.emptyTitle: You are not recorded as acting for any premises.
reg02.emptyText: Ask the premises principal to add you as a delegate.
reg02.oaeTitle: An application is already in progress
reg02.oaeText: This premises already has an application of this kind in progress, so no second one was started. Open that application to continue; its reference is shown with this message.
reg02.relTitle: The register does not link this premises to your company
reg02.relText: The premises register does not show this premises as operated by the party you act for, so no application was started. If the register is out of date, update the premises record first, then start again.
reg02.naTitle: No authority to act for this premises
reg02.naText: You are not recorded as acting for this premises at this moment, so nothing changed. If you are its principal or hold its delegation, check the delegates in the premises record, then try again.
reg02.supText: The decision you chose has been replaced by a later one, so it cannot be changed. Open the decision now in force and report the change from there.
reg02.ipi: This period cannot be used: the end must be after the start (for a change, the start must be before the end of the decision being changed), and no day of it may already be covered by another decision of this premises. Nothing was recorded. Choose a period that begins after the last day already covered. To change a decision, open the decision now in force and report the change from there.
reg02.pre: A charged period cannot start before the registration date. No obligation arises for use before registration until a separate decision on it takes effect, and the date the use began is still recorded. Choose a start date on or after the registration date.
reg02.acr: Say why the decision is being changed: what changed at the premises, or why the decision should change. A change after an appeal also needs the appeal case reference. Nothing was recorded.
reg02.pnfTitle: The earlier decision was not found
reg02.pnfText: No earlier decision of this premises was found to renew or change, so no application was started. Open the decision from the premises’ list of decisions and start from there.

reg03.knownDesc: You do not need to enter these.
reg03.changed: Changed in the register since your last decision.

reg04.title: Documents and claims
reg04.afterText: RightOne asks for this when you send the application; you then have until the date it gives.
reg04.consequence: If you do not use one kind of music right, that part of the fee can be removed. A reviewer decides every claim, so the decision is not immediate, and the full fee applies until the claim is decided.
reg04.noRemove: A claim you add stays with this application until it is decided or the application is withdrawn, so it cannot be removed here.
reg04.stillNoneText: You can go on to the review.
reg04.emptyText: No document is needed for this registration. Add a claim only if the premises does not use a kind of music right, or holds a direct licence for it.
reg04.offStill: Still needed: {count} items. Add them to go on to the review.
reg04.offStillOne: Still needed: 1 item. Add it to go on to the review.
reg04.offRna: The registration rules are not approved yet, so the review is not available. Your draft is kept.
reg04.docInvalid: This file was not accepted: it is empty, was damaged in the upload, or is not an allowed format. Upload it again; nothing was saved.
reg04.duplicate: The application already has a claim of this kind for this rights layer, so no second one was made. Add the documents to the existing claim.
reg04.periodInvalid: A claim's period must fall within the registered period, and its end must be after its start. Choose the dates again; the claim was not made.
reg04.layerUnknown: The rights layer chosen is not one the registration rules list, so the claim was not made. Choose a rights layer from the list.

reg05.exText: You claimed the small-business exemption. “One premises per business” is not met, so the ordinary fee applies.
reg05.beforeText: You began playing music on {date}. No fee is raised now for the time before this registration. The date you began is kept on record, because a later rule may apply to that time.

reg05.section1.title: What the fee covers
reg05.section1.body: The fee pays for playing recorded music to customers at this premises during the registered period. It covers three rights: authors’ rights, performers’ rights and producers’ rights. RightOne passes each part to the organisation that represents that right.
reg05.section2.title: How the fee is worked out
reg05.section2.body: Each right has its own amount in the tariff, set by the premises class and the customer area. If a claim is accepted, the part for that right is removed; while a claim is being reviewed, that part is still charged.
reg05.section3.title: What is not covered
reg05.section3.body: Live performances, ticketed events and music played outside the premises are not covered by this fee. Each needs its own arrangement.
reg05.section4.title: If you do not pay, or pay late
reg05.section4.body: Pay by the date on the decision. If the fee is not paid by then, the amount is still owed, and RightOne sends a reminder that says what happens next.
reg05.section5.title: Telling RightOne when an answer changes
reg05.section5.body: If an answer you gave changes, such as the customer area or how music is played, report the change within 30 days. RightOne then works out the fee again from the date of the change.
reg05.section6.title: How to appeal a decision
reg05.section6.body: If you disagree with a decision, you can appeal within 30 days of the date it was issued, from the decision page. An officer who did not take the decision reviews the appeal.

reg06.box1: The answers are true for {premises}, and I may act for it.
reg06.box1Help: You confirm for {party}, as premises principal.
reg06.box2: I will tell RightOne when any of these answers changes.

reg06.supText: The explanation or the registration rules changed after you reviewed the application, so your confirmation was not recorded, or the application was not sent. Review it again with the current text, then confirm again.

reg06.perText: This application cannot be decided, because another decision of this premises already covers some days of its period. Nothing was recorded, and the application stays as it was. Its period cannot be changed: withdraw it and start a new application for the days not yet covered.
reg06.enaText: The explanation of your rights and of how the fee is worked out is not approved yet, so your confirmation cannot be recorded. Your answers are kept. This is for RightOne to resolve; there is nothing you need to do.
